Maximum MAC addresses per port is configurable
Sticky MAC learning learns addresses automatically

errors.solution: Use 'shutdown' then 'no shutdown' on interface to recover

questions.question: What command shows port security status?
What does sticky learning do?
questions.solution: Dynamically learns and saves MAC addresses to running-config
